reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkExternalBankAccount/linkBankAccount helpers (so the duplicate-link refusal, bank keying and initial sync come for free), and the Fintegra balance path joins Akahu's existing branch.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a third copy of the Pluggy/Akahu download function it merges them into downloadSyncServerTransactions used by all three providers.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and type in types/models, matching where the tree puts each provider piece.

scope.why: The download consolidation and the desktop-client type-forced entries go slightly beyond the server-only request, but they are small and directly enable the change.

maintainability.why: Adding Fintegra is mostly declarative and the merged download helper reduces future provider cost.
